title: Implement recommender filter, band, sort with tests
description:
js/recommender.js rank(hikes, forecasts, {dayIndex, filters, month}) -> Band[]. Pipeline: filter (inSeason, access exclude, country, tags any) -> band by weatherScore -> sort by hike score ascending. Hikes without a forecast go to an unknown band last. Pure.

Acceptance: tests cover each filter, band ordering good > fair > poor > nogo > unknown, and score order within a band.

From docs/plans/0001-hiker-web-app.md, section "Components > recommender".
